take_homes: What you tell the AI first changes its answer, so tell it who you are and how we work.
You can save your rules in a file and the agent reads it every time. I could do that for depot reporting.
The AI is too nice about its own work and it fills gaps with guesses, so I check it myself.

misconception.why: Everything today was about my LinkedIn and a personal site, plus chat examples about dinner. I did not see it do anything with an operational file. The rules file idea made me think a little, but I still think of AI as a chat tool.

one_line: Nice that the site came out looking like me, but I made a personal website, not anything for the depots, and there was a lot of English to read.
